mapper.select: SELECT ec.challenge_id AS challengeId, ecu.user_challenge_id AS userChallengeId, ecu.user_id AS userId, ecu.current_level AS currentLevel, ecu.current_target AS currentTarget, ecu.exp AS exp, ecu.status AS status, ecu.updated_at AS updatedAt, ecl.challenge_level_id AS challengeLevelId, ecl.level AS level, ecl.required_exp AS requiredExp, ecl.reward_point AS rewardPoint, ec.max_level AS maxLevel FROM event_challenge_user_tbl ecu JOIN event_challenge_tbl ec ON ec.challenge_id = ecu.challenge_id JOIN event_challenge_level_tbl ecl ON ecl.challenge_id = ecu.challenge_id AND ecl.level = ecu.current_level WHERE ecu.user_id = #{userId} AND NOW() BETWEEN ec.start_date AND ec.end_date ORDER BY ec.challenge_id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_challenge_user_tbl (user_id, challenge_id, current_level, current_target, exp, status, updated_at) SELECT #{userId}, ec.challenge_id, 1, 0, 0, 'PROCESS', NOW() FROM event_challenge_tbl ec WHERE NOW() BETWEEN ec.start_date AND ec.end_date AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM event_challenge_user_tbl ecu WHERE ecu.user_id = #{userId} AND ecu.challenge_id = ec.challenge_id ) ORDER BY ec.challenge_id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.select: SELECT ecu.user_challenge_id AS userChallengeId, ecu.user_id AS userId, ecu.challenge_id AS challengeId, ecu.current_level AS currentLevel, ecu.current_target AS currentTarget, ecu.exp AS exp, ecu.status AS status, ecu.updated_at AS updatedAt, ecl.challenge_level_id AS challengeLevelId, ecl.level AS level, ecl.required_exp AS requiredExp, ecl.reward_point AS rewardPoint, ec.max_level AS maxLevel FROM event_challenge_user_tbl ecu JOIN event_challenge_tbl ec ON ec.challenge_id = ecu.challenge_id JOIN event_challenge_level_tbl ecl ON ecl.challenge_id = ecu.challenge_id AND ecl.level = ecu.current_level WHERE ecu.user_id = #{userId} AND ecu.challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND NOW() BETWEEN ec.start_date AND ec.end_date FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE event_challenge_user_tbl ecu JOIN ( SELECT challenge_id FROM event_challenge_tbl WHERE NOW() BETWEEN start_date AND end_date ORDER BY challenge_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) active_challenge ON active_challenge.challenge_id = ecu.challenge_id JOIN event_reward_tbl er ON er.reward_id = #{rewardId} SET ecu.exp = ecu.exp + er.reward_exp, ecu.updated_at = NOW() WHERE ecu.user_id = #{userId} AND ecu.status = 'PROCESS'

UPDATE event_challenge_user_tbl ecu JOIN event_challenge_level_tbl ecl ON ecl.challenge_id = ecu.challenge_id AND ecl.level = ecu.current_level JOIN event_challenge_tbl ec ON ec.challenge_id = ecu.challenge_id SET ecu.current_level = ecu.current_level + 1, ecu.updated_at = NOW() WHERE ecu.user_id = #{userId} AND ecu.challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND ecu.exp >= ecl.required_exp AND ecu.current_level < ec.max_level AND ecu.status = 'PROCESS'

UPDATE event_challenge_user_tbl ecu JOIN event_challenge_level_tbl ecl ON ecl.challenge_id = ecu.challenge_id AND ecl.level = ecu.current_level JOIN event_challenge_tbl ec ON ec.challenge_id = ecu.challenge_id SET ecu.status = 'REWARDED', ecu.updated_at = NOW() WHERE ecu.user_id = #{userId} AND ecu.challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND ecu.current_level = ec.max_level AND ecu.exp >= ecl.required_exp AND ecu.status = 'PROCESS'
mapper.select: SELECT e.event_id AS eventId, e.event_name AS eventName, e.event_desc AS eventDesc, e.event_type AS eventType, e.event_category AS eventCategory, e.event_img_name AS eventImgName, e.event_daily_limit_count AS eventDailyLimitCount, e.event_target AS eventTarget, er.reward_id AS rewardId, er.reward_point AS rewardPoint, er.reward_exp AS rewardExp, CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'ATTENDANCE' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_attendance_tbl ea WHERE ea.event_id = e.event_id AND ea.user_id = #{userId} AND ea.participated_at >= eu.joined_at ) ELSE ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_participation_tbl ep WHERE ep.event_id = e.event_id AND ep.user_id = #{userId} AND ep.participated_at >= eu.joined_at ) END AS partCount, DATE_FORMAT(e.end_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS endAt FROM event_tbl e LEFT JOIN event_reward_tbl er ON er.event_id = e.event_id LEFT JOIN event_user_tbl eu ON eu.event_id = e.event_id AND eu.user_id = #{userId} WHERE e.event_status = 'OPEN' AND (e.start_at IS NULL OR NOW() >= e.start_at) AND (e.end_at IS NULL OR NOW() <= e.end_at) ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.event_id DESC

SELECT e.event_id AS eventId, e.event_name AS eventName, e.event_desc AS eventDesc, e.event_type AS eventType, e.event_category AS eventCategory, e.event_img_name AS eventImgName, er.reward_id AS rewardId, err.received_at AS receivedAt, COALESCE(er.reward_point, 0) AS rewardPoint, COALESCE(er.reward_exp, 0) AS rewardExp FROM event_reward_receive_tbl err JOIN event_tbl e ON e.event_id = err.event_id JOIN event_reward_tbl er ON er.event_id = err.event_id AND er.reward_id = err.reward_id WHERE err.user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(err.received_at, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} ORDER BY err.received_at DESC

SELECT e.event_id AS eventId, e.event_name AS eventName, e.event_desc AS eventDesc, e.event_type AS eventType, e.event_category AS eventCategory, e.event_status AS eventStatus, e.event_img_name AS eventImgName, e.event_target AS eventTarget, e.event_level AS eventLevel, e.event_daily_limit_count AS eventDailyLimitCount, e.start_at AS startAt, e.end_at AS endAt, er.reward_id AS rewardId, COALESCE(er.reward_point, 0) AS rewardPoint, COALESCE(er.reward_exp, 0) AS rewardExp, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_participation_tbl ep WHERE ep.event_id = e.event_id AND ep.user_id = #{userId} AND eu.joined_at IS NOT NULL AND ep.participated_at >= eu.joined_at) AS currentTargetCount, (eu.event_user_id IS NOT NULL) AS joined, (eu.event_user_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_participation_tbl ep WHERE ep.event_id = e.event_id AND ep.user_id = #{userId} AND ep.participated_at >= eu.joined_at) >= e.event_target ) AS completed, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_reward_receive_tbl err WHERE err.event_id = e.event_id AND err.user_id = #{userId}) AS rewardReceived FROM event_tbl e LEFT JOIN event_reward_tbl er ON er.event_id = e.event_id LEFT JOIN event_user_tbl eu ON eu.event_id = e.event_id AND eu.user_id = #{userId} WHERE e.event_type != 'ATTENDANCE' AND e.event_status = 'OPEN' AND (e.start_at IS NULL OR NOW() >= e.start_at) AND (e.end_at IS NULL OR NOW() <= e.end_at) ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.event_id DESC

SELECT e.event_id AS eventId, e.event_name AS eventName, e.event_desc AS eventDesc, e.event_type AS eventType, e.event_category AS eventCategory, e.event_status AS eventStatus, e.event_img_name AS eventImgName, e.event_target AS eventTarget, e.event_level AS eventLevel, e.event_daily_limit_count AS eventDailyLimitCount, e.start_at AS startAt, e.end_at AS endAt, er.reward_id AS rewardId, COALESCE(er.reward_point, 0) AS rewardPoint, COALESCE(er.reward_exp, 0) AS rewardExp, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_attendance_tbl ea WHERE ea.event_id = e.event_id AND ea.user_id = #{userId} AND eu.joined_at IS NOT NULL AND ea.participated_at >= eu.joined_at) AS currentTargetCount, (eu.event_user_id IS NOT NULL) AS joined, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_attendance_tbl ea WHERE ea.event_id = e.event_id AND ea.user_id = #{userId} AND eu.joined_at IS NOT NULL AND ea.participated_at >= eu.joined_at AND DATE(ea.participated_at) = CURDATE()) AS todayAttendanceCompleted, (eu.event_user_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_attendance_tbl ea WHERE ea.event_id = e.event_id AND ea.user_id = #{userId} AND ea.participated_at >= eu.joined_at) >= e.event_target ) AS completed, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_reward_receive_tbl err WHERE err.event_id = e.event_id AND err.user_id = #{userId}) AS rewardReceived FROM event_tbl e LEFT JOIN event_reward_tbl er ON er.event_id = e.event_id LEFT JOIN event_user_tbl eu ON eu.event_id = e.event_id AND eu.user_id = #{userId} WHERE e.event_type = 'ATTENDANCE' AND e.event_status = 'OPEN' AND (e.start_at IS NULL OR NOW() >= e.start_at) AND (e.end_at IS NULL OR NOW() <= e.end_at) ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.event_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO event_user_tbl (user_id, event_id, joined_at) SELECT #{userId}, e.event_id, NOW() FROM event_tbl e WHERE e.event_id = #{eventId} AND e.event_type != 'ATTENDANCE' AND e.event_status = 'OPEN' AND (e.start_at IS NULL OR NOW() >= e.start_at) AND (e.end_at IS NULL OR NOW() <= e.end_at)

INSERT IGNORE INTO event_user_tbl (user_id, event_id, joined_at) SELECT #{userId}, e.event_id, NOW() FROM event_tbl e WHERE e.event_id = #{eventId} AND e.event_type = 'ATTENDANCE' AND e.event_status = 'OPEN' AND (e.start_at IS NULL OR NOW() >= e.start_at) AND (e.end_at IS NULL OR NOW() <= e.end_at)
mapper.select: SELECT event_user_id FROM event_user_tbl WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND event_id = #{eventId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_attendance_tbl (event_id, user_id, participated_at) SELECT e.event_id, #{userId}, NOW() FROM event_tbl e JOIN event_user_tbl eu ON eu.event_id = e.event_id AND eu.user_id = #{userId} WHERE e.event_id = #{eventId} AND e.event_type = 'ATTENDANCE' AND e.event_status = 'OPEN' AND (e.start_at IS NULL OR NOW() >= e.start_at) AND (e.end_at IS NULL OR NOW() <= e.end_at) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_attendance_tbl ea WHERE ea.event_id = e.event_id AND ea.user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(ea.participated_at) = CURDATE()) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_attendance_tbl ea WHERE ea.event_id = e.event_id AND ea.user_id = #{userId} AND ea.participated_at >= eu.joined_at) < e.event_target

INSERT INTO event_participation_tbl (event_id, user_id, participated_at) SELECT e.event_id, #{userId}, NOW() FROM event_tbl e JOIN event_user_tbl eu ON eu.event_id = e.event_id AND eu.user_id = #{userId} WHERE e.event_category = #{eventCategory} AND e.event_type != 'ATTENDANCE' AND e.event_status = 'OPEN' AND eu.joined_at <= NOW() AND (e.start_at IS NULL OR NOW() >= e.start_at) AND (e.end_at IS NULL OR NOW() <= e.end_at) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_participation_tbl ep WHERE ep.event_id = e.event_id AND ep.user_id = #{userId} AND ep.participated_at >= eu.joined_at) < e.event_target
mapper.select: SELECT er.reward_id AS rewardId, e.event_id AS eventId, e.event_type AS eventType, e.event_level AS eventLevel, e.event_target AS eventTarget, er.reward_point AS rewardPoint, er.reward_exp AS rewardExp, (eu.event_user_id IS NOT NULL) AS joined, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_reward_receive_tbl err WHERE err.event_id = e.event_id AND err.user_id = #{userId}) AS rewardReceived, CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'ATTENDANCE' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_attendance_tbl ea WHERE ea.event_id = e.event_id AND ea.user_id = #{userId} AND eu.joined_at IS NOT NULL AND ea.participated_at >= eu.joined_at ) ELSE ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_participation_tbl ep WHERE ep.event_id = e.event_id AND ep.user_id = #{userId} AND eu.joined_at IS NOT NULL AND ep.participated_at >= eu.joined_at ) END AS currentTargetCount FROM event_tbl e JOIN event_reward_tbl er ON er.event_id = e.event_id AND er.reward_id = #{rewardId} LEFT JOIN event_user_tbl eu ON eu.event_id = e.event_id AND eu.user_id = #{userId} WHERE e.event_id = #{eventId} AND e.event_status = 'OPEN' AND (e.start_at IS NULL OR NOW() >= e.start_at) AND (e.end_at IS NULL OR NOW() <= e.end_at)

SELECT e.event_id AS eventId, e.event_name AS eventName, TRUE AS completed
FROM event_tbl e JOIN event_user_tbl eu ON eu.event_id = e.event_id AND eu.user_id = #{userId}
WHERE e.event_category = #{eventCategory} AND e.event_type != 'ATTENDANCE' AND e.event_status = 'OPEN' AND (e.start_at IS NULL OR NOW() >= e.start_at) AND (e.end_at IS NULL OR NOW() <= e.end_at)
-- 현재 목표는 달성했지만 AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_participation_tbl ep WHERE ep.event_id = e.event_id AND ep.user_id = #{userId} AND ep.participated_at >= eu.joined_at ) >= e.event_target
-- 보상 수령 여부 등을 기준으로 -- 이미 완료 처리한 이벤트는 제외 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM event_reward_receive_tbl err WHERE err.event_id = e.event_id AND err.user_id = #{userId} )
ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 1

SELECT e.event_id AS eventId, e.event_name AS eventName, TRUE AS completed
FROM event_tbl e
JOIN event_user_tbl eu ON eu.event_id = e.event_id AND eu.user_id = #{userId}
WHERE e.event_id = #{eventId}
AND e.event_type != 'ATTENDANCE' AND e.event_status = 'OPEN'
AND (e.start_at IS NULL OR NOW() >= e.start_at) AND (e.end_at IS NULL OR NOW() <= e.end_at)
-- 현재 목표 달성 AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_participation_tbl ep WHERE ep.event_id = e.event_id AND ep.user_id = #{userId} AND ep.participated_at >= eu.joined_at ) >= e.event_target
-- 이미 보상을 받은 이벤트는 제외 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM event_reward_receive_tbl err WHERE err.event_id = e.event_id AND err.user_id = #{userId} )
